rows.text: Mr. Jibaou the radish! Glad to see you again. Congratulations on discovering the hidden stage of the Pixel World!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: This hidden stage will make you question your life choices!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Now, you have no other means to cross the rapid stream, and there are three massive piranhas before you! You can only bet your life on a piranha that appears the friendliest and jump into its stomach to let it carry you across the river... Of course, you might perish in its belly if you make the wrong choice.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You stay in the piranha's stomach, waiting to cross the sea... You think to yourself, "Luckily, it doesn't eat carrots." Save your progress immediately when you reach the other side!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
